title: D2P Digest
description: Content digests of digest profile 'd2p-digest-v1': 'sha256:' plus the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical form 'd2p-c14n-v1' (members removed per digest kind, numbers quantized half-to-even to 9 fractional digits of the canonical unit, -0 mapped to 0, serialized per RFC 8785 JCS). The quantization step is a canonicalization parameter, not a tolerance. The root accepts a digest string.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: SHA-256 digest in the form 'sha256:<64 lowercase hex digits>'. In 1.0, sha256 is the only algorithm.

inputRole.title: Input role
inputRole.description: Role of a pinned input of a derived document. The roles pattern, grading-rule-set, body-measurement-profile, size-system, garment-measurement-spec and fit-profile identify an artifact revision; measurement-definition-registry, tolerance-profile and validation-profile identify a versioned vocabulary or profile; material-assumptions identifies the inline material assumptions of an evaluation request.

inputDigest.title: Input digest
inputDigest.description: Digest of one pinned input. With 'artifactRef': the referenced revision's contentDigest. With 'id': the canonical form of the whole vocabulary or profile document with that id and version. For 'material-assumptions': the canonical form of the request's inline materialAssumptions object. Presence of 'artifactRef' and 'id' by role is schema-enforced.

artifactRef.description: Pinned artifact revision; required for artifact roles, forbidden otherwise.

id.description: Versioned ID of a vocabulary or profile; required for the roles measurement-definition-registry, tolerance-profile and validation-profile, forbidden otherwise.

digest.description: Digest of the input as defined for its role.
